notes: The first route has four co-transmitters at one level (two bare relations, «أبي» and «أخي», and two names) «جميعا عن أحمد بن إدريس».

The second chain after the saying («حدثني محمد بن يعقوب الكليني») is a second isnad for the same saying («مثله سواء»), so it is its own group; «بإسناده» is a back reference, with no previous report supplied.
«سمعت الرضا يقول» names the Imam in the words after the chain, so he is the last link, kind imam_in_text.
